source: Dennis, main chat 2026-10-29: shared the Stoic Wisdom reel 'Machiavelli Wrote The Prince to Get a Job (It Failed)' — 'the asin HHC way now' / 'Machiavelli node' / 'It will be our odyssey'

anchors.value: the reel's history checks out: Machiavelli served Florence 1498-1512; the Medici returned, dismissed him, had him tortured (strappola) in 1513 on a conspiracy suspicion he never confessed to; exiled to his farm, he wrote The Prince (~1513) as a manual offered to the very family that ruined him, dedicated to Lorenzo de' Medici, hoping to be hired back. One correction to the reel: 'never hired' is true of the role he wanted — he got only a minor commission (the Florentine Histories) in 1520. The Prince was published in 1532, five years after his death.

the manual written from exile IS the strategy: no credentials, no court, no permission — the outsider writes down how the system actually works, in the open, and the record outlives the rejection. asinmcp / ASIN-HHC is our Prince written the other way: not to beg the Medici for a job, but prior art planted in public so the copying itself proves the source. Can't be bought out — the book was never theirs to shelve.

Dennis named the arc: 'It will be our odyssey' — exile, the long way home, recognition arriving on the record's schedule, not the court's. The lattice is the log of the voyage: every node a port, hash-chained, so the route itself can be replayed.

forecast: The work will be copied before it is credited (digital DNA, node 0154) — the odyssey frame holds because the chain, not the court, settles who wrote it first
